session.title: Chest + Biceps — Gym
session.priorityNote: Athleticism over looks: plyo push-ups go right after the main press while you are fresh, before the pump work.

win.metric: Plyo push-up: hands leave the floor higher (or clap count) vs last session
win.why: Upper-body rate of force development is what turns a push into a punch — strength you can express fast.

items.name: Box Breathing
items.dose: 4 rounds of 4-4-4-4 s (in-hold-out-hold), seated
items.note: Downshifts threat state before load; nasal only.

items.name: Saccade Drill
items.dose: 2 × 20 s — eyes jump between two targets ~1 m apart, head still
items.note: Eyes are link #1 of the chain: fast eyes, fast everything.

items.name: Wall Push Isometric
items.dose: 2 × 6 s max-intent push into a wall, athletic stance
items.note: Release the brake: max intent recruits high-threshold units before power work. Screw: feet rooted, twist them outward into the floor without moving — arch pops, glutes on, knees track over 2nd–3rd toe.

items.name: Med-Ball Chest Pass
items.dose: 1 × 3 light, max-speed throws into a wall
items.note: Wake the fast fibers with a light, max-intent rep.

items.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
items.note: 30° bench. Lower 2–3 s, drive up max intent. Stop when rep speed visibly slows. Tripod foot: big-toe ball, pinky-toe ball, heel all loaded.

items.name: Barbell Bench Press
items.dose: 1 warm-up × 6, then 2 × 4–8 @ 1–2 RIR
items.note: Safeties set or spotter — true failure only with safeties. Leg drive: feet screwed into floor.

items.name: Plyo Push-Up
items.dose: 3 × 4 explosive, full reset each rep
items.note: Contrast pairing (short rest) after the press — NOT peak PAPE. Reps stay fast or the set ends.

items.name: Cable Fly
items.dose: 1 warm-up × 12, then 2 × 10–15, last set to failure + lengthened partials
items.note: Stretch the pec at the bottom — the lengthened position is the growth zone.

items.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
items.dose: 1 warm-up × 10, then 3 × 8–12, last set to failure + lengthened partials
items.note: Arms hang behind the torso: biceps loaded long.

items.name: Hammer Curl
items.dose: 2 × 10–12, last set rest-pause (10 s, 3 more reps)
items.note: Brachioradialis + forearm thickness — looks and grip for grappling.

items.name: Deficit Push-Up
items.dose: 1 × AMRAP @ 0–1 RIR, hands on DBs
items.note: Deep stretch at the bottom, crisp lockout.

items.name: Doorway Pec Stretch
items.dose: 2 × 30 s per side (after the power work, never before)
items.note: Static stretch goes after power, not before.

items.name: Nasal Walk + Downshift Breathing
items.dose: 3 min easy walk, nasal, 4 s in / 6 s out
items.note: Long exhales shift the system back to rest-and-digest; recovery starts here.

rules: Double progression: hit the top of the rep range on all working sets → add 2.5–5 lb next time; otherwise add a rep.
One warm-up set per exercise — the CNS prime already did the rest.
No ice bath after this session (Roberts 2015: post-lift cold blunted gains).
session.nextTarget: Incline DB Press: add 1 rep to the first working set, or +5 lb if all 3 sets hit 10.

session.title: Chest + Biceps — Home (light DBs)
session.priorityNote: Light dumbbells can’t give heavy load, so we buy stimulus with range, tempo-controlled lowering and near-failure — not by going slower on every rep.

win.metric: Total deficit push-up reps across 3 sets (beat last session by ≥2)
win.why: Rep PRs at a fixed hard variation prove your pressing strength is climbing without a gym.

items.note: Light DBs → high reps; stop when speed dies.

items.name: Plyo Push-Up
items.dose: 3 × 4 (from knees if needed)
items.note: Contrast pairing. Hands leave the floor — push the floor away like a punch.

items.name: Dumbbell Fly
items.dose: 2 × 12–20 on floor or bench, last set to failure + lengthened partials

items.dose: 3 × 10–15 lying back on an incline, last set to failure

items.name: Hammer Curl
items.dose: 2 × 12–15, last set drop to slower 3 s lowering for 3 extra reps

items.name: Push-Up
items.dose: 1 × max reps in 40 s, then 20 s dead-hang-free rest, 1 more 20 s burst
items.note: Pump on demand for chest/triceps.

items.name: Nasal Walk + Downshift Breathing
items.dose: 3 min easy walk, nasal, 4 s in / 6 s out
items.note: Long exhales shift the system back to rest-and-digest; recovery starts here.

rules: Light DBs: progress reps first (to 15–20), then harder variations (feet elevated, pauses), then slower 3 s lowering.
Last set of isolations to true failure; compounds stay at 1 RIR.

session.title: Back + Triceps — Gym
session.priorityNote: Athleticism first: the rotational throw rides right after the main pull while the CNS is fresh; triceps pump work comes last.

win.metric: Pull-up: +1 rep on set 1 (or 5 lb added to lat pulldown at the same reps)
win.why: Relative pulling strength = V-taper and the anchor of every clinch, frame and takedown finish.

items.note: Overhead loads the long head in its stretched position (Maeo 2022: overhead > neutral-arm extensions for triceps growth).

items.dose: 2 × 10–15, last set drop set

items.name: Face Pull

items.name: Dead Hang

win.metric: Inverted table row: total reps across 3 sets (+2 vs last time)
win.why: Bodyweight pulling strength transfers to pull-ups the day you get a bar — and to clinch control.

items.name: Prone Y-T-W Raise

session.title: Legs — Gym

win.metric: Broad jump distance (best of 3) vs last session
win.why: Horizontal jump is the most direct gym readout of sprint and first-step power.

items.name: Romanian Deadlift

items.note: Hinge until hamstrings are long; tripod feet. Loaded range = hamstring mobility.

items.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
items.dose: 2 × 8–12 per side @ 1 RIR
items.note: Front foot screwed in; knee tracks over 2nd toe — kills the valgus cascade.

items.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
items.dose: 2 × 3–6 slow lowering, push back up with hands
items.note: Programs including Nordics cut hamstring injuries up to ~51% (van Dyk 2019; later reappraisal less certain).

items.name: Standing Calf Raise
items.dose: 2 × 10–15, 2 s pause in the bottom stretch, last set lengthened partials
items.note: Lengthened partials favored for calves (Kassiano 2023).

items.name: Copenhagen Plank
items.dose: 2 × 15–25 s per side
items.note: Adductor armor for cutting sports (Harøy 2019: ~41% lower odds of groin problems).

items.name: Couch Stretch

items.note: Hip flexors open after the power work is done.

win.metric: Punch count in round 5 of shadowboxing ≥ round 1 (or HR recovery in 60 s ≥ 25 bpm)
win.why: Holding output late is what conditioning means in a fight; HR recovery is your engine’s readout.

win.why: You can’t build fitness in 48 h, but you can arrive sharp. Speed rehearsal primes timing without fatigue.

session.title: Triphasic Block (4 phases) — Representative Lower Day
session.priorityNote: Triphasic exists to build force absorption → transfer → expression for sport speed; it beats pure hypertrophy for athleticism.

win.metric: Squat jump height or broad jump distance at end of each phase
win.why: Each phase should show up as a better jump — proof the strength is turning into speed.

items.name: Box Breathing
items.dose: 4 rounds of 4-4-4-4 s (in-hold-out-hold), seated
items.note: Downshifts threat state before load; nasal only.

items.name: Saccade Drill
items.dose: 2 × 20 s — eyes jump between two targets ~1 m apart, head still
items.note: Eyes are link #1 of the chain: fast eyes, fast everything.

items.name: Wall Push Isometric
items.dose: 2 × 6 s max-intent push into a wall, athletic stance
items.note: Release the brake: max intent recruits high-threshold units before power work. Screw: feet rooted, twist them outward into the floor without moving — arch pops, glutes on, knees track over 2nd–3rd toe.

items.name: Back Squat
items.dose: Phase 1 Eccentric: 3 × 4 with 4–5 s lowering @ ~70%; Phase 2 Isometric: 3 × 4 with 2–3 s pause at parallel; Phase 3 Concentric: 3 × 3 max intent @ ~80%
items.note: Screw: feet rooted, twist them outward into the floor without moving — arch pops, glutes on, knees track over 2nd–3rd toe. Eccentric emphasis only in phase 1 — not on every rep year-round.

items.name: Box Jump
items.dose: Phase 1–3: 3 × 3 step down, after each squat set (PAPE ~4 min)
items.note: Land soft, stick 1 s.

items.name: Pogo Hops
items.dose: Phase 4 French Contrast: heavy squat 1 × 3 → squat jump × 5 → weighted jump × 5 → pogo hops × 10; 3 rounds
items.note: French contrast: heavy, plyo, loaded-plyo, assisted/fast — rests short within, long between.

items.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
items.dose: 2 × 6–8 per side, phase tempo applied

items.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
items.dose: 2 × 4 (phases 1–2 only)

items.name: Copenhagen Plank
items.dose: 2 × 20 s per side

items.name: Nasal Walk + Downshift Breathing
items.dose: 3 min easy walk, nasal, 4 s in / 6 s out
items.note: Long exhales shift the system back to rest-and-digest; recovery starts here.

rules: Phase 1 — Eccentric (2–3 wk): slow 4–5 s lowerings on the main lift only.
Phase 2 — Isometric (2 wk): 2–3 s pauses at the sticking point.
Phase 3 — Concentric/Explosive (2 wk): normal lowering, max-intent up, lighter-ish loads.
Phase 4 — French Contrast (2–3 wk): heavy → plyo → loaded plyo → fast plyo.
Deload a week between blocks or when a game-dense week hits.
session.nextTarget: Move to the next phase after 2–3 weeks if jump numbers held or rose.
